  "description": "Pack &lsquo;N&rsquo; Pay is a product of CIC Integrated Services LTD. CIC was created as a wholesale store that supplies food to offshore catering companies to feed the offshore workers. Pack &rsquo;N&rsquo; Pay was created as a product that would leverage technology to solve the problems of retailers and wholesalers. Pack &lsquo;N&rsquo; Pay officially started operations on January 18th 2021 and launched her e-commerce website on March 1st 2021.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Accounting Manager

Job Location: Head Office, Port Harcourt - Rivers&nbsp;
Employment Type: Full-time
Department: Finance &amp; Accounts

Role Summary


	We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Accounting Manager to oversee the day-to-day operations of the Accounting Department.
	The successful candidate will supervise the accounting team, ensure accurate financial reporting, maintain strong internal controls, and ensure compliance with statutory and regulatory requirements.
	This role will work closely with the CEO and CFO to provide timely financial insights that support sound business decisions while ensuring the integrity of the company&#39;s financial records.


Key Responsibilities
Financial Management &amp; Reporting


	Supervise the daily activities of the Accounting Department.&nbsp;
	Prepare accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports.&nbsp;
	Maintain the general ledger and ensure accurate recording of all financial transactions.&nbsp;
	Coordinate month-end and year-end closing activities.&nbsp;
	Prepare management accounts and provide financial insights to support decision-making.&nbsp;
	Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning processes.&nbsp;
	Monitor cash flow and working capital requirements.&nbsp;
	Conduct financial analysis, cost analysis, and variance reporting.&nbsp;
	Ensure payroll-related accounting entries are accurately posted.&nbsp;


Compliance &amp; Internal Controls


	Ensure compliance with tax laws and statutory obligations including VAT, PAYE, WHT, Pension, NSITF, ITF, and other regulatory requirements.&nbsp;
	Maintain strong internal controls to safeguard company assets.&nbsp;
	Coordinate internal and external audits and implement audit recommendations.&nbsp;
	Ensure accounting policies comply with applicable accounting standards and company procedures.&nbsp;


Inventory &amp; Cost Control


	Oversee inventory accounting and stock reconciliation.&nbsp;
	Work closely with warehouse and operations teams to maintain inventory accuracy.&nbsp;
	Monitor cost trends and recommend cost-saving initiatives.&nbsp;
	Support periodic inventory counts and reconciliations.&nbsp;


Team Leadership:


	Supervise, coach, and develop members of the Accounting Department.&nbsp;
	Allocate work, review outputs, and ensure high standards of accuracy.&nbsp;
	Collaborate with Operations, Procurement, HR, Sales, and other departments to improve business performance.&nbsp;
	Drive continuous improvement in accounting processes and financial controls.&nbsp;


Requirements


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline.&nbsp;
	Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in accounting, finance, or financial management, including supervisory responsibilities.&nbsp;
	Professional certification such as ICAN, ACA, ACCA, or equivalent is an added advantage.&nbsp;
	Strong knowledge of financial reporting, taxation, budgeting, internal controls, and accounting principles.&nbsp;
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting/ERP software (Zoho experience is an advantage).&nbsp;
	Strong analytical, problem-solving, and leadership skills.&nbsp;
	Excellent communication, integrity, and attention to detail.&nbsp;


Benefits


	Competitive salary.&nbsp;
	Health Insurance.&nbsp;
	Pension Contribution.&nbsp;
	Professional development opportunities.&nbsp;
	Collaborative work environment.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should forward their CV to: hr@packnpay.com.ngusing &quot;Accounting Manager&quot; as the subject of the mail.",

Accounting Manager Job at Pack ‘N’ Pay




        
    

        
        Pack ‘N’ Pay is a product of CIC Integrated Services LTD. CIC was created as a wholesale store that supplies food to offshore catering companies to feed the offshore workers. Pack ’N’ Pay was created as a product that would leverage technology to solve the problems of retailers and wholesalers. Pack ‘N’ Pay officially started operations on January 18th 2021 and launched her e-commerce website on March 1st 2021.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Accounting Manager

Job Location: Head Office, Port Harcourt - Rivers 
Employment Type: Full-time
Department: Finance & Accounts

Role Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Accounting Manager to oversee the day-to-day operations of the Accounting Department.
	The successful candidate will supervise the accounting team, ensure accurate financial reporting, maintain strong internal controls, and ensure compliance with statutory and regulatory requirements.
	This role will work closely with the CEO and CFO to provide timely financial insights that support sound business decisions while ensuring the integrity of the company's financial records.


Key Responsibilities
Financial Management & Reporting


	Supervise the daily activities of the Accounting Department. 
	Prepare accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports. 
	Maintain the general ledger and ensure accurate recording of all financial transactions. 
	Coordinate month-end and year-end closing activities. 
	Prepare management accounts and provide financial insights to support decision-making. 
	Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning processes. 
	Monitor cash flow and working capital requirements. 
	Conduct financial analysis, cost analysis, and variance reporting. 
	Ensure payroll-related accounting entries are accurately posted. 


Compliance & Internal Controls


	Ensure compliance with tax laws and statutory obligations including VAT, PAYE, WHT, Pension, NSITF, ITF, and other regulatory requirements. 
	Maintain strong internal controls to safeguard company assets. 
	Coordinate internal and external audits and implement audit recommendations. 
	Ensure accounting policies comply with applicable accounting standards and company procedures. 


Inventory & Cost Control


	Oversee inventory accounting and stock reconciliation. 
	Work closely with warehouse and operations teams to maintain inventory accuracy. 
	Monitor cost trends and recommend cost-saving initiatives. 
	Support periodic inventory counts and reconciliations. 


Team Leadership:


	Supervise, coach, and develop members of the Accounting Department. 
	Allocate work, review outputs, and ensure high standards of accuracy. 
	Collaborate with Operations, Procurement, HR, Sales, and other departments to improve business performance. 
	Drive continuous improvement in accounting processes and financial controls. 


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline. 
	Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in accounting, finance, or financial management, including supervisory responsibilities. 
	Professional certification such as ICAN, ACA, ACCA, or equivalent is an added advantage. 
	Strong knowledge of financial reporting, taxation, budgeting, internal controls, and accounting principles. 
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting/ERP software (Zoho experience is an advantage). 
	Strong analytical, problem-solving, and leadership skills. 
	Excellent communication, integrity, and attention to detail. 


Benefits


	Competitive salary. 
	Health Insurance. 
	Pension Contribution. 
	Professional development opportunities. 
	Collaborative work environment.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should forward their CV to: [email protected]using "Accounting Manager" as the subject of the mail.

Sales Officer Job at Seplon Energy




        
    

        
        Seplon Energy is a renewable energy company based in Abuja, Nigeria. We provide green energy solutions to both the industrial and domestic sectors. Our products include sales and installation of solar panels, inverters, lithium batteries at scale.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Sales Officer

Job Location: Abuja (FCT) 
Employment Type: Full-time

Requirements
     

            
    




	Minimum qualification of an OND
	At least 2 years of proven experience in sales and/or marketing.
	Strong ability to generate leads and convert prospects into customers.
	Demonstrated experience in meeting and exceeding sales targets.
	Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
	Ability to develop and implement effective marketing strategies.
	Experience with digital marketing tools (social media, email marketing, online ads).
	Strong customer relationship management (CRM) skills.
	Ability to analyze market trends and competitor activities.
	Good presentation and proposal writing skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
	Self-motivated with strong organizational and time management skills.
	Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
	Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
	Willingness to travel for client meetings and field marketing activities.
	Be based in Abuja.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Project Manager - Male Job at Denaro Properties Limited




        
    

        
        Denaro Properties Limited began operation in 2011 as a leading brand in the real estate development segment of the Nigerian economy. Our scope of operation includes residential housing development and management, site and services estate development, joint venture developments and Financial advisory.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Project Manager - Male

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Project Manager to oversee our residential development projects.


Requirements
     

            
    




	B.Sc. or HND qualification in Civil Engineering, Building Technology, or a related construction discipline.
	Minimum of 7 years of hands-on experience supervising residential housing construction projects.
	Not more than 43 years of age.
	Strong attention to detail with excellent quality control skills
	Proven ability to manage multiple construction sites simultaneously.
	Ability to interpret architectural, structural, M&E, and other construction drawings.
	Good understanding of project costing, budgeting, and cost control.
	Ability to prepare site reports and maintain accurate project documentation.
	Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, and Project). Knowledge of AutoCAD or other construction software is an added advantage.
	Must be able to work under pressure and meet strict project deadlines.
	Membership or registration with relevant professional bodies (e.g., COREN, NSE, NIOB, or CORBON) will be an added advantage.


Salary
Attractive and negotiable based on experience.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Note: Only qualified candidates should apply.

Customer Care Representative (Morning and Night Shift) Job at Snappy Exchange




        
    

        
        SnappyExchange is a customer-focused digital trading platform that enables users to trade gift cards as well as purchase airtime, data, and pay bills. We prioritize providing a seamless, user-friendly experience through our mobile app and website to make digital transactions effortless for our customers.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Customer Care Representative (Morning and Night Shift)

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Manage incoming calls.
	Identify and assess customers needs to achieve satisfaction.
	Build sustainable relationships and trust with customer accounts through open and interactive communication
	Provide accurate, valid and complete information by using the right methods/tools
	Handle customer complaints, provide appropriate solutions and alternatives within the time limits; follow up to ensure resolution.
	Follow communication procedures, guidelines and policies.
	Take the extra mile to engage customers.
	Online customer management and ability to resolve issues.


Basic Requirements


	B.Sc / HND / ND qualification
	1 - 2 years of work experience.
	Gender: Female.
	Age: 20-27 years.
	Residence within Ikeja or places closer to Ikeja is a criteria.


Salary
N120,000 monthly.

Note


	Residence within Ikeja or places closer to Ikeja is a criteria.
	Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the interview.
